segments.name: Amusement parks
segments.description: Operates amusement parks in China for visitors, earning in-park recreation sales and rental income from leasing parks to third-party operators.
segments.evidence: All six parks have been identified as an operating segment and meets the criteria for aggregation due to similar economic characteristics.

revenueModel.text: Visitors pay charges for access to rides and attractions, and operators and tenants pay rent to the company.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales of in-park recreation primarily consist of charges for access to rides and attractions.

changes.text: In November and December 2024 the Company transitioned from amusement park operator to amusement park lessor.
changes.evidence: The Company transitioned from amusement park operator to amusement park lessor.
